name: Question 11
worked_solution:
Multiplying the matrices using the usual method, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}AB & =[\begin{aligned}1-3\text{i} & -1+2\text{i} \\ 2+2\text{i} & 1-\text{i}\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}3-\text{i} & 3+\text{i} \\ -1+\text{i} & 1-\text{i}\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}(1-3\text{i})(3-\text{i})+(-1+2\text{i})(-1+\text{i}) & (1-3\text{i})(3+\text{i})+(-1+2\text{i})(1-\text{i}) \\ (2+2\text{i})(3-\text{i})+(1-\text{i})(-1+\text{i}) & (2+2\text{i})(3+\text{i})+(1-\text{i})(1-\text{i})\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-10\text{i}+(-1-3\text{i}) & (6-8\text{i})+(1+3\text{i}) \\ (8+4\text{i})+2\text{i} & (4+8\text{i})+(-2\text{i})\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-1-13\text{i} & 7-5\text{i} \\ 8+6\text{i} & 4+6\text{i}\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Question 11
?

If A=[1−3i−1+2i2+2i1−i] and B=[3−i3+i−1+i1−i], then AB=

a
[−1+13i7+5i8+6i4+6i]
b
[−1−13i7−5i8+6i4+6i]
c
[4+6i8+6i7−5i−1−13i]
d
[4+6i7−5i8+6i−1−13i]
e
[−1−13i8+6i7−5i4+6i]
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

Multiplying the matrices using the usual method, we get

AB=[1−3i−1+2i2+2i1−i]⋅[3−i3+i−1+i1−i]=[(1−3i)(3−i)+(−1+2i)(−1+i)(1−3i)(3+i)+(−1+2i)(1−i)(2+2i)(3−i)+(1−i)(−1+i)(2+2i)(3+i)+(1−i)(1−i)]=[−10i+(−1−3i)(6−8i)+(1+3i)(8+4i)+2i(4+8i)+(−2i)]=[−1−13i7−5i8+6i4+6i].
